g.text: Current repository design | Warm auctions have no Redis or DSP network calls
Each replica owns its caches. Redis distributes changes to every replica.
Solid arrows: request / local data flow
Deployment: local Compose runs Redis; monitoring has a separate Compose file. A load balancer can front multiple adserver instances.
Outside this service: budgets, pacing, frequency caps, attribution, billing, fraud checks and creative review.
